title: Retry-After: 0 when rpm > 60 invites retry storm
description: When admin.rate_limit_rpm > 60 (e.g. 120), the expression `(60u32 / rpm).min(60)` truncates to 0 via integer division. The server responds HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 0, which RFC 7231 clients interpret as 'retry immediately'. This causes tight retry loops from rate-limited callers — the opposite of the intended back-off. Example: rpm=120 → Retry-After: 0. Fix: use ceiling division `((60u32 + rpm - 1) / rpm).max(1)` or use f64 rounding. Present in both crates/reader/src/admin.rs and crates/transit/src/admin.rs.
